en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges shows a rural landscape viewed from a shaded uphill road framed by large overhanging tree branches. The road leads down to a narrow bridge crossing a river or valley and continues toward a small settlement of scattered houses and farm buildings in open fields with low hills in the distance. Wooden utility poles line the road. The caption "GAUJIENA." appears in white letters at the lower left of the image, and small initials and numbers ("PM RIGA 187") appear at the lower right.
